BURGER BLASTER

Slope-intercept form. Feed every Muncher in 10 forts. Run out of burgers and the run is over.

1. Answer2 questions before each fort. Right answers make special burgers.
2. FlingDrag back and let go, or aim with WASD or the arrows and press Space.
3. SurviveClear a fort to win a burger back. Clear it in a few shots for one more.
